properties.notes: Redevelopment of vacant site (formerly a working mens club -D2 use class) to residential development (Use class C3) comprising the erection of two four storey blocks of 16 flats, block fronting Craven Park Road with 11 flats (4 x 1bed, 7 x 2bed) and block fronting Nicoll Road with 5 flats (1 x 1bed , 2 x 2bed and 2 x 3bed), with associated cycle parking, bin stores, landscaping, amenity space and re-instatement of drop kerb (car free development) and subject to a Deed of Agreement dated 13 July 2017 under Section 106 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990, as amended
